parsedVerdict.reasoning: The src/domain module covers one concern: the task-management domain. It holds the entities (Task, Project, User), the task status value type, the domain errors, and the ports the domain needs (one repository interface per entity, plus IdGenerator). The abstractions are used the same way throughout. Each repository has the same save/findById shape. TaskRepository's filter reuses TaskStatus instead of redefining it. Task.status is typed by TaskStatus. Errors come from domain-error.ts rather than plain Error throws. Each rule lives in one place: the list of allowed statuses and its validation are only in task-status.ts (TASK_STATUSES, parseTaskStatus), and the 'already done' rule is only in Task.markDone. Task.markDone uses the literal 'done', but the type checker ties it to the TaskStatus union, so it is not a second copy of the status list. Project and User have the same shape, but that is not a shared invariant written twice. Nothing splits the module into unrelated concerns or goes around its own abstractions.
